about.text: A loaf-shaped pressed cheese made in Roubaix since the early 20th century, in two versions, demi-vieux and extra-vieux. It is ripened 11 to 12 months at about 15 °C on wood, turned and brushed by hand once a month, and is drier than Mimolette.

sources.text: The ripening, the turning, the shape, the two versions and the origin, from the article.
